title: Northgate Card Bonus on Northgate Cash Earnings
content:
**Bonus.** Under the consumer earning schedule of Northgate Rewards and Northgate+ Memberships, paying with a Northgate Card adds percentage points to the earning percentage of the line the schedule settles:

1. A line paid with a Northgate Card whose account is a **Northgate Store Card**, **Northgate Mastercard** or **Northgate World Mastercard** in active status adds **1** percentage point.
2. A line paid with a Northgate Card whose account is a **Northgate Secured Card** in active status adds **0.5** percentage points.
3. Any other line adds no points.

The payment method and the paying card account are those recorded on the order line; the card's tier and status are those of that account on Northgate Card Credit Accounts (issued by Harbor Point Bank, N.A.).

**Condition table**

| Line paid with a Northgate Card | Card account tier | Account status | Points added |
|---|---|---|---|
| yes | Northgate Store Card, Northgate Mastercard or Northgate World Mastercard | active | 1 |
| yes | Northgate Secured Card | active | 0.5 |
| yes | any tier | suspended, closed or charged off | none |
| yes | Northgate Business Store Card or Northgate Business Mastercard | active | none |
| no (external card or other tender) | — | — | none |
